change.title: Bound the Desktop Science third-party control subprocess
change.summary: Replaces only the Desktop post-start third-party Science control call's bare Command output wait with a same-crate bounded primitive: one absolute deadline, capped stdout and stderr, a private process group, descendant termination and direct-child reap, and typed failure, timeout, and output-limit outcomes. The fixed Gateway argv, environment-only control URL, loopback and JSON policy, route-state behavior, and existing user-visible error categories remain unchanged.

basis: Desktop caller and Gateway and skill-package responsibility inventory at the P1 base
focused Desktop tests for success, spawn failure, nonzero exit, absolute timeout, stdout and stderr limits, descendant cleanup, cleanup-failure reaper ownership, invalid JSON, and incomplete response
existing Science control runner timeout, environment, and descendant-cleanup regression tests
Python source-contract coverage for fixed Gateway argv and environment-only control URL
source-gate and run-evidence contract coverage with the updated Rust Desktop test inventory count
pre-commit and exact-commit clean-context independent source reviews plus the exact-commit recursive GATE-SOURCE completion seal
